Written by audit_batch.py import-reads; read only through lineage_reads.load, the one normalization.

scope-1985: Sequential/Relative/Indexed I-O: a block (physical record) holds one or more logical records, or part of one; its size has no direct relationship to the size of the file or of the logical records

citations.quote: The size of a block has no direct relationship to the size of the file
citations.check: OK  §1985:III.2 p17  (2. <u>DEFINITIONS</u>)  the text is in p17

cases.reason: The refuter's objection stands: beyond the definition, the row states "The size of a block has no direct relationship to the size of the file", a property a program can see violated (a file padded to whole blocks returns extra records), and its subject is the medium, which the definitional arm excludes. No 2023 pointer carries an 85 witness of it. Own witness rerun now at --std 85: 3 records through BLOCK CONTAINS 5 RECORDS come back as exactly 3.
cases.needs: needs-own-witness: place blkfile.cob as the row's case
